brief: Design an interface for a "Dream Decay Calculator" where users input memories from their dreams each morning and watch them literally dissolve and fragment throughout the day based on neurological for

dominant_strengths: Atmospheric midnight palette and italic serif framing evoke the dreamlike, neurological tone the brief invites.
Conceptual ambition is high: timeline of day-phases plus retention formula reflects genuine thought about decay metaphor.
Input card uses restrained underline fields that feel journal-like and appropriate to memory capture.
dominant_weaknesses: Severe text overlap on 'Preserved Fragments' / rightmost nav label signals broken layout and damages craft credibility.
Vast empty middle void—no visible decaying fragments, geometry, or visualization—leaves the core promise of the brief invisible.
Composition is unbalanced: tiny intro top-left, form bottom-left, formula bottom-right, with no anchoring center of gravity.
fix_priorities: Fix the navigation collision and establish a clear active-phase indicator with proper spacing math.
Populate the canvas with the actual crystallizing/fracturing memory geometry—this is the entire product.
Rebalance composition: center the visualization, dock controls, and tie the retention formula to live decay state.
Elevate typography hierarchy so intro copy, card title, and formula share a coherent serif/mono system.
rationale.norman_balance: Reflective concept outweighs visceral payoff, and behavioral usability is undermined by overlapping nav and an empty stage with no feedback.
rationale.intent_fit: Partially fits—the scaffolding (timeline, formula, morning recall form) gestures at the brief, but the dissolving-fragments spectacle that defines the concept is absent.
